background: HSBC UK Bank plc is the ring-fenced retail and commercial bank of HSBC in Britain, funded by UK personal and business deposits and lending on residential mortgages and to UK companies, including first direct.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest of them at A+, two on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026, the ring-fenced bank is rated high with momentum upward. Liquidity and leverage are the strength, with LCR of 160% above the UK majors median and NSFR of 143% and leverage of 5.6% in the top quarter, while CET1 of 13.2% in the bottom quarter is the softer figure. Since 30 Jun 2025 LCR has fallen 26 points and NSFR 8 points, while CET1 and leverage have been broadly flat. Flagged news in the last 90 days is about job cuts in the UK wealth business, the newest on 8 Oct 2026, not credit.
